idleSub: Lumphani kuti mutenge zabwino ndi kudumpha zoipa.
pausedSub: Dinani kapena kanikizani Enter kuti mupitirize kuthamanga.
emptySub: Onjezani zina m'masewerawa kuti athe kuseweredwa.
copyFail: Mawuwo asankhidwa. Wakopereni ndi Ctrl kapena Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Masewera othamanga. Munthuyo amathamanga yekha. Lumphani kuti mutenge malingaliro abwino ndi kupewa oipa.
stageHow: Kanikizani Space, Enter, muvi wopita m'mwamba kapena W kuti mulumphe. Kanikizani Escape kuti muyimitse. Kanikizani Tab kuti mupitirize. Zonse za m'masewerawa zalembedwanso pansi pa Werengani popanda kusewera.
hintKeys: Space, muvi wa m'mwamba kapena W kuti mulumphe
guideText: Tengani zomwe zili mbali ya malamulo a web component. Lumphani zomwe si web yachibadwidwe.
